description: Update evergreen queue settings. Control whether the queue is active, how many posts per day, posting times, and default cooldown period.

default_cooldown_days.description: Default days to wait before reposting (1-90)

enabled.description: Enable or disable the evergreen queue

posting_times.description: Array of posting times in "HH:mm" format (e.g. ["09:00", "17:00"])

posts_per_day.description: Number of evergreen posts to publish per day (1-10, limited by plan)

name: opentweet_update_evergreen_settings
